records.item: Lydian electrum coin (twenty-fourth stater, lion's paw type)

source.title: Electrum twenty-fourth stater, lion's paw (Sardis Expedition artifact LATW 23)
source.accession: Ephesus Museum inv. 99/43/94; Ephesus Excavations ART 94/K277
source.site: Artemision at Ephesus, sacrificial deposit (deepest layers)
source.dateStated: ca. 630-615 BC (terminus ante quem ca. 615 BC from stratigraphy)

secondary.title: The Earliest Coins at Ephesus (Macquarie University ACANS)
secondary.caveat: Page notes scholarly debate on whether the Artemision electrum is circulating money or temple dedication, and on the weight standard's origin. The page's own date line has a CE/BCE typo; do not rely on it for numbers.

records.reliability: medium-high for dating of this coin type; origin of coinage as a whole remains debated

gameplay.craftable: needs hand-authored recipe (electrum alloy + die striking); pack route 'coin_striking_die + money' is unreviewed
